speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for clarifying; the worsening post-nasal drip at night is a strong clue. Have you noticed any congestion, runny nose, or sneezing accompanying this, and do you have any history of allergies or sinus problems? Also, do you smoke or have any exposure to chemical fumes or dust?

speaker: Doctor
text: That history of seasonal allergies combined with the worsening symptoms when lying down strongly suggests allergic rhinitis or post-nasal drip syndrome. Also, have you noticed any heartburn or a sour taste in your mouth, which might indicate reflux as a contributing factor?
